content.text:
I fixed all three problems in `src/queue.js`, and `npm test` now passes (7 of 7).

- **Hang after a failure:** a rejected job never freed its slot, so the queue stalled. A job that throws or returns a plain value, instead of a promise, is now handled too. Every job, whether it succeeds or fails, now frees its slot and lets the next job start.
- **`onIdle()` resolving early:** it only checked that nothing was pending. It now also waits until nothing is running.
- **Only one job after `resume()`:** `next()` started a single job per call. It now starts jobs in a loop until the slots are full, so `resume()` fills all free slots.

I added five regression tests in `test/queue.test.js`:
- a failing job rejects only its own promise and the queue keeps going
- a synchronous throw and a plain return value are handled
- `onIdle()` waits for running jobs
- `onIdle()` resolves immediately when the queue is already idle
- `resume()` with concurrency 4 and 6 queued jobs starts four

I didn't check whether the new tests fail against the old code.
